The patcher now manages updates for the patched app. Choose **Update installed mods** to fetch the latest compatible patch, verify it, rebuild the app, and open Android's installer.

- Handle **Open patcher** from the patched app's purple/lilac boot notice.
- Publish JavaScript patches independently of patcher releases.
- Prevent old downloaded bundles from overriding newly prepared installations.
- Keep the update flow and dialogs in the patcher's purple theme.
- Include patch v0.4.3 and remove the patched app's update checker controls.

Keep the patcher installed and retain its app data to preserve your device signing key. Android confirms installation; app data remains in place when the signing key matches.
